entries.text: 此人不能告诉你什么。
entries.source_text: 此人不能告诉你什么。

entries.text: You see a Vault dweller.
entries.source_text: You see a Vault dweller.

entries.text: 你看见一个避难所居民。
entries.source_text: 你看见一个避难所居民。

entries.text: I can't believe that you betrayed us!
entries.source_text: I can't believe that you betrayed us!

entries.text: 我不敢相信居然是你背叛了我们！
entries.source_text: 我不敢相信居然是你背叛了我们！

entries.text: Traitor!
entries.source_text: Traitor!

entries.text: 叛徒！
entries.source_text: 叛徒！

entries.text: I hate you. Why did you ever come back?!
entries.source_text: I hate you. Why did you ever come back?!

entries.text: 我恨你。你还回来干什么？！
entries.source_text: 我恨你。你还回来干什么？！

entries.text: I hope you choke on your vileness!
entries.source_text: I hope you choke on your vileness!

entries.text: 老天为什么不惩罚你这个恶人！
entries.source_text: 老天为什么不惩罚你这个恶人！

entries.text: Thank you for saving us.
entries.source_text: Thank you for saving us.

entries.text: 感谢你救了我们。
entries.source_text: 感谢你救了我们。

entries.text: I was a little unsure that you could do it, but I trust you now.
entries.source_text: I was a little unsure that you could do it, but I trust you now.

entries.text: 过去我有点不相信你有能力做到，但现在我相信你了。
entries.source_text: 过去我有点不相信你有能力做到，但现在我相信你了。

entries.text: Thank you! Thank you!
entries.source_text: Thank you! Thank you!

entries.text: 谢谢你！谢谢你！
entries.source_text: 谢谢你！谢谢你！

entries.text: You are a hero. My little boy wants to be just like you when he grows up. I don't know if I like that.
entries.source_text: You are a hero. My little boy wants to be just like you when he grows up. I don't know if I like that.

entries.text: 你是一个英雄。我的儿子想要长大后和你一样，但我不确定我是否喜欢他这样。
entries.source_text: 你是一个英雄。我的儿子想要长大后和你一样，但我不确定我是否喜欢他这样。

entries.text: You are a heroine. My little girl wants to be just like you when she grows up. I don't know if I like that.
entries.source_text: You are a heroine. My little girl wants to be just like you when she grows up. I don't know if I like that.

entries.text: 你是一个英雄。我的女儿想要长大后和你一样，但我不确定我是否喜欢她这样。
entries.source_text: 你是一个英雄。我的女儿想要长大后和你一样，但我不确定我是否喜欢她这样。

entries.text: You are a swell guy!
entries.source_text: You are a swell guy!

entries.text: 你真是个棒小伙！
entries.source_text: 你真是个棒小伙！

entries.text: You are a swell gal!
entries.source_text: You are a swell gal!

entries.text: 你真是个好姑娘！
entries.source_text: 你真是个好姑娘！

entries.text: Are you sure you need that in here?
entries.source_text: Are you sure you need that in here?

entries.text: 你确定在这需要它吗？
entries.source_text: 你确定在这需要它吗？

entries.text: That's a weapon!
entries.source_text: That's a weapon!

entries.text: 那是个武器！
entries.source_text: 那是个武器！

entries.text: Have you actually used that against someone?
entries.source_text: Have you actually used that against someone?

entries.text: 你确实曾用那个对着人吗？
entries.source_text: 你确实曾用那个对着人吗？

entries.text: Why do you think it is necessary to carry a weapon in here?
entries.source_text: Why do you think it is necessary to carry a weapon in here?

entries.text: 你为什么认为在带着武器是必要的？
entries.source_text: 你为什么认为在带着武器是必要的？

entries.text: It's good to see you again.
entries.source_text: It's good to see you again.

entries.text: 很高兴再次见到你。
entries.source_text: 很高兴再次见到你。

entries.text: I'm glad you are doing well.
entries.source_text: I'm glad you are doing well.

entries.text: 你一切顺利我感到很高兴。
entries.source_text: 你一切顺利我感到很高兴。

entries.text: You look OK to me. All those rumors must be untrue.
entries.source_text: You look OK to me. All those rumors must be untrue.

entries.text: 你看起来挺好。那些传言一定是假的。
entries.source_text: 你看起来挺好。那些传言一定是假的。

entries.text: Hi
entries.source_text: Hi

entries.text: 嗨，
entries.source_text: 嗨，

entries.text: . Keep up the good work.
entries.source_text: . Keep up the good work.

entries.text: 。再接再厉。
entries.source_text: 。再接再厉。

entries.text: I hope everything is going well out there. We sure could use the water.
entries.source_text: I hope everything is going well out there. We sure could use the water.

entries.text: 我希望外面一切正常。我们确定水是可以使用的。
entries.source_text: 我希望外面一切正常。我们确定水是可以使用的。

entries.text: We are starting to run out of water. This is terrible!
entries.source_text: We are starting to run out of water. This is terrible!

entries.text: 我们的水要用完了。这太可怕了！
entries.source_text: 我们的水要用完了。这太可怕了！

entries.text: Please hurry and find that chip. We need you.
entries.source_text: Please hurry and find that chip. We need you.

entries.text: 请快点找到那个芯片。我们需要你。
entries.source_text: 请快点找到那个芯片。我们需要你。

entries.text: I'm glad you are doing well. Keep up the good work.
entries.source_text: I'm glad you are doing well. Keep up the good work.

entries.text: 你一切顺利我很高兴。继续努力。
entries.source_text: 你一切顺利我很高兴。继续努力。

entries.text: I hate to say this, but if you don't find the water chip soon, we're all going to die.
entries.source_text: I hate to say this, but if you don't find the water chip soon, we're all going to die.

entries.text: 我不想提这个，但是如果你不快点找到净水芯片的话我们会死的！
entries.source_text: 我不想提这个，但是如果你不快点找到净水芯片的话我们会死的！

entries.text: My little one is always crying in the middle of the night for a drink of water and I can't give her anything.
entries.source_text: My little one is always crying in the middle of the night for a drink of water and I can't give her anything.

entries.text: 我的孩子总是在半夜因为口渴又哭又闹，但我什么也给不了她。
entries.source_text: 我的孩子总是在半夜因为口渴又哭又闹，但我什么也给不了她。

entries.text: We're not going to make it, are we?
entries.source_text: We're not going to make it, are we?

entries.text: 我们办不到，是不是？
entries.source_text: 我们办不到，是不是？

entries.text: The water rations are coming to an end.
entries.source_text: The water rations are coming to an end.

entries.text: 水配给要完蛋了。
entries.source_text: 水配给要完蛋了。

entries.text: The hydroponics section has closed down now. It means our food supply is running out.
entries.source_text: The hydroponics section has closed down now. It means our food supply is running out.

entries.text: 水耕区已经关闭了。说明食物供给也要用完了。
entries.source_text: 水耕区已经关闭了。说明食物供给也要用完了。

entries.text: Hmm. You still look human to me. It can't be all that bad outside.
entries.source_text: Hmm. You still look human to me. It can't be all that bad outside.

entries.text: 嗯。看起来你仍然是个人。外面的情况没有那么糟糕。
entries.source_text: 嗯。看起来你仍然是个人。外面的情况没有那么糟糕。

entries.text: Hi
entries.source_text: Hi

entries.text: 嗨，
entries.source_text: 嗨，

entries.text: I hope you are doing well on your quest.
entries.source_text: I hope you are doing well on your quest.

entries.text: 我希望你的任务一帆风顺
entries.source_text: 我希望你的任务一帆风顺

entries.text: See you around.
entries.source_text: See you around.

entries.text: 回头见。
entries.source_text: 回头见。

entries.text: Have you talked to the Overseer recently?
entries.source_text: Have you talked to the Overseer recently?

entries.text: 你最近和所长谈话了吗？
entries.source_text: 你最近和所长谈话了吗？

entries.text: The Overseer is very concerned about the status of your mission.
entries.source_text: The Overseer is very concerned about the status of your mission.

entries.text: 所长非常关心你任务的状况。
entries.source_text: 所长非常关心你任务的状况。

entries.text: You need to hurry. We can't afford any failure on your part.
entries.source_text: You need to hurry. We can't afford any failure on your part.

entries.text: 你要快点。你失败我们就完了。
entries.source_text: 你要快点。你失败我们就完了。

entries.text: I hope you are doing the best you can.
entries.source_text: I hope you are doing the best you can.

entries.text: 我希望你在尽全力。
entries.source_text: 我希望你在尽全力。

entries.text: This is no time to rest, get back out there.
entries.source_text: This is no time to rest, get back out there.

entries.text: 没时间休息了，快离开这儿。
entries.source_text: 没时间休息了，快离开这儿。

entries.text: This isn't what you are supposed to be doing, is it?
entries.source_text: This isn't what you are supposed to be doing, is it?

entries.text: 这不是你现在应该在做的事，对吧？
entries.source_text: 这不是你现在应该在做的事，对吧？

entries.text: We're going to die, and it's your fault.
entries.source_text: We're going to die, and it's your fault.

entries.text: 我们要死了，这全是你的错。
entries.source_text: 我们要死了，这全是你的错。

entries.text: Don't just stand here, get back out there! Now!
entries.source_text: Don't just stand here, get back out there! Now!

entries.text: 别光站着，离开这！现在！
entries.source_text: 别光站着，离开这！现在！

entries.text: If we die, it will be your fault.
entries.source_text: If we die, it will be your fault.

entries.text: 如果我们死了，全是你的错。
entries.source_text: 如果我们死了，全是你的错。

entries.text: The outside has corrupted you, hasn't it?
entries.source_text: The outside has corrupted you, hasn't it?

entries.text: 外面把你毁了，对不对？
entries.source_text: 外面把你毁了，对不对？

entries.text: Just leave me alone.
entries.source_text: Just leave me alone.

entries.text: 离我远点。
entries.source_text: 离我远点。

entries.text: I think you should leave me and my family alone,
entries.source_text: I think you should leave me and my family alone,

entries.text: 我认为你应该离开我和我的家人，
entries.source_text: 我认为你应该离开我和我的家人，

entries.text: . It would be for the best.
entries.source_text: . It would be for the best.

entries.text: 。这也是好意。
entries.source_text: 。这也是好意。

entries.text: You should be ashamed of yourself.
entries.source_text: You should be ashamed of yourself.

entries.text: 你应该为你的行为感到羞耻。
entries.source_text: 你应该为你的行为感到羞耻。

entries.text: And to think that I used to like you.
entries.source_text: And to think that I used to like you.

entries.text: 而且认为我过去喜欢你。
entries.source_text: 而且认为我过去喜欢你。

entries.text: The Vault dweller refuses to talk to you.
entries.source_text: The Vault dweller refuses to talk to you.

entries.text: 这个避难所居民拒绝和你谈话。
entries.source_text: 这个避难所居民拒绝和你谈话。

entries.text: An empty stare meets your request to talk.
entries.source_text: An empty stare meets your request to talk.

entries.text: 一个空洞的眼神让你无法开口。
entries.source_text: 一个空洞的眼神让你无法开口。

entries.text: I regret that we picked you to go outside.
entries.source_text: I regret that we picked you to go outside.

entries.text: 我后悔选你去外面。
entries.source_text: 我后悔选你去外面。

entries.text: The water is foul, but your company is worse.
entries.source_text: The water is foul, but your company is worse.

entries.text: 水脏，你的同伙更脏。
entries.source_text: 水脏，你的同伙更脏。

entries.text: Go away. Just leave. You can redeem yourself by finding that water chip.
entries.source_text: Go away. Just leave. You can redeem yourself by finding that water chip.

entries.text: 走啊。离开。找到净水芯片才能弥补你的过失。
entries.source_text: 走啊。离开。找到净水芯片才能弥补你的过失。

entries.text: I hope you are satisfied.
entries.source_text: I hope you are satisfied.

entries.text: 我希望你满意。
entries.source_text: 我希望你满意。

entries.text: The Vault dweller refuses to talk to you.
entries.source_text: The Vault dweller refuses to talk to you.

entries.text: 这个避难所居民拒绝和你谈话。
entries.source_text: 这个避难所居民拒绝和你谈话。

entries.text: You caused this! You probably broke the water chip in the first place, too!
entries.source_text: You caused this! You probably broke the water chip in the first place, too!

entries.text: 都是你引起的！当初也是你把净水芯片破坏的！
entries.source_text: 都是你引起的！当初也是你把净水芯片破坏的！

entries.text: I hate you. I really, really hate you.
entries.source_text: I hate you. I really, really hate you.

entries.text: 我恨你。我真的恨死你了。
entries.source_text: 我恨你。我真的恨死你了。

entries.text: The Vault dweller just sobs great big tears.
entries.source_text: The Vault dweller just sobs great big tears.

entries.text: 这个避难所居民默默地流泪。
entries.source_text: 这个避难所居民默默地流泪。

entries.text: Your request to talk is met by a cold stare.
entries.source_text: Your request to talk is met by a cold stare.

entries.text: 一个冷漠的眼神让你无法开口。
entries.source_text: 一个冷漠的眼神让你无法开口。

entries.text: Thank you.
entries.source_text: Thank you.

entries.text: 谢谢你。
entries.source_text: 谢谢你。

entries.text: It's late. Come back some other time.
entries.source_text: It's late. Come back some other time.

entries.text: 太晚了。换个时候再来。
entries.source_text: 太晚了。换个时候再来。

entries.text: The Vault dweller is resting.
entries.source_text: The Vault dweller is resting.

entries.text: 这个避难所居民在休息。
entries.source_text: 这个避难所居民在休息。
